description: A pale orange block with a rind of wax that nobody has ever successfully removed in one piece. Grown in a tank on the eastern edge, from cultures nobody has audited in decades. It smells like a memory of a farm. It melts, which is the only thing anyone actually asks of it.
name: vat cheese
